content: 1. Shelly D and Gujral S (2017) conducted an immunohistochemical evaluation of four lymph node biopsies to study Early T-Cell Precursor Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia/Lymphoma. This study was published in the Journal of Clinical Diagnostic Research, volume 11, issue 7, pages EL01–EL02. The article is accessible via PMC 5583929. 2. You MJ, Medeiros LJ, and Hsi ED (2015) provided a detailed analysis of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma in the American Journal of Clinical Pathology, volume 144, issue 3, pages 411–422. The study is available under DOI: 10.1309/AJCPMF03LVSBLHPJ. 3. Rose MG (2004) explored T-Cell Large Granular Lymphocyte Leukemia and related disorders in The Oncologist, volume 9, issue 3, pages 247–258. The article is identified by ISSN 1083-7159. 4. Liu EB et al. (2012) published a study in Zhonghua Bing Li Xue Za Zhi, volume 41, issue 4, pages 229–233, focusing on T-cell lymphomas. The study explicitly utilized et al. for multiple authorship. 5. Osuji N et al. (2005) conducted a comparative review of the histopathology of the spleen in T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia and T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia. This work appeared in the American Journal of Surgical Pathology, volume 29, issue 7, pages 935–941. 6. Graham RL, Cooper B, and Krause JR (2013) discussed T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the Proceedings of Baylor University Medical Center, volume 26, issue 1, pages 19–21. The article is available via PMC 3523759. 7. Matutes E (2007) provided insights into Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the Journal of Clinical Pathology, volume 60, issue 12, pages 1373–1377. The study is accessible via PMC 2095573 and PMID 18042693. 8. Shimoyama M (1991) established diagnostic criteria and classification for clinical subtypes of adult T-cell leukemia-lymphoma in the British Journal of Haematology, volume 79, issue 3, pages 428–437. The study is indexed under PMID 1751370. 9. Al-Ahmad S et al. (2017) presented a case report and literature review on systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive, in Acta Clinica Belgica, volume 72, issue 6, pages 454–460. The article is identified by ISSN 1784-3286. 10. Yu L, Yan LL, and Yang SJ (2014) reported on the sarcomatoid variant of ALK-anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving multiple lymph nodes and lungs, with cytokine production, in the International Journal of Clinical and Experimental Pathology, volume 7, issue 8, pages 4806–4816. The study is available via PMC 4152041. 11. De Campos FPF et al. (2014) described an unusual clinical presentation of anaplastic large cell lymphoma in Autopsy Case Reports, volume 4, issue 1, pages 21–27. The article is accessible via PMC 5470561. 12. Watanabe M et al. (2008) investigated hypomethylation of CD30 CpG islands and aberrant JunB expression in Hodgkin lymphoma and anaplastic large cell lymphoma. This study was published in Laboratory Investigation, volume 88, issue 1, pages 48–57. 13. Girardi M (2017) reviewed Mycosis Fungoides and Sézary Syndrome in Hematology/Oncology Clinics of North America, volume 31, issue 2, pages 297–315. The article is identified by ISSN 0889-8588. 14. Campbell J, Clark R, and Kupper TS (2010) discussed the distinct T-cell subsets underlying Sézary syndrome and mycosis fungoides in Blood, volume 116, issue 5, pages 767–771. The study is available under DOI: 10.1182/blood-2009-11-251926. 15. Bernengo MG et al. (2002) provided an update on erythrodermic cutaneous T-cell lymphoma in the Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology, volume 46, issue 1, pages 95–106. The article is identified by ISSN 0190-9622. 16. Parveen Z and Thompson K (2009) redefined diagnostic criteria for subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma in the Arch Pathol Lab Med, volume 133, issue 2, pages 303–308. The study is indexed under PMID 19195975. 17. Van de Meeberg MM et al. (2016) reported on hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma in a Crohn's disease patient on thiopurine monotherapy in the World Journal of Gastroenterology, volume 22, issue 47, pages 10465–10470. The article is available via PMC 5175260. 18. Shi Y and Wang E (2015) reviewed hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma with an emphasis on diagnostic differentiation in Archives of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine, volume 139, issue 9, pages 1173–1180. 19. Alsohaibani FI et al. (2011) discussed hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma in the Indian Journal of Hematology and Blood Transfusion, volume 27, issue 1, pages 39–42. The study is accessible via PMC 3102508. 20. Vose J et al. (2011) analyzed enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma in Blood, volume 118, issue 1, pages 148–155. The study is available under DOI: 10.1182/blood-2011-02-335216. 21. Bautista-Quach MA et al. (2012) reviewed gastrointestinal lymphomas in the Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology, volume 3, issue 3, pages 209–225. The article is accessible via PMC 3418529. 22. Quintanilla-Martinez L et al. (1999) described peripheral T-cell lymphoma with Reed-Sternberg-like cells associated with Epstein-Barr virus infection in the American Journal of Surgical Pathology, volume 23, issue 10, pages 1233–1240. The study is indexed under PMID 10524524. 23. Lemonnier F et al. (2012) identified recurrent TET2 mutations in peripheral T-cell lymphomas in Blood, volume 120, issue 7, pages 1466–1469. The study is available under DOI: 10.1182/blood-2012-02-408542. 24. Jha KK et al. (2017) discussed peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, in the Journal of Family Medicine and Primary Care, volume 6, issue 2, page 427. The article is identified by ISSN 2249-4863.
